method.stamp: 11×11 detector pixels per exposure, read from the Level 2 file (IMAGE and FLAGS)
method.aperture: 5×5-pixel sum above the local sky (median of the stamp outside the central 7×7)
method.units: µJy with the nominal 6.15″ pixel (1 MJy/sr over one pixel = 889.0 µJy); relative, not calibrated photometry
method.errors: the pipeline VARIANCE plane summed over the aperture plus the sky level’s uncertainty (the sky’s robust scatter alone where an exposure has no VARIANCE)
method.wavelength: each exposure’s own spectral WCS at the position (WCS-WAVE table)
method.leftOut: outside the detector or within 5 px of its edge; saturated (a masked pixel or the OVERFLOW flag in the box); another hard flag in the box (cosmic ray, bad or hot pixel). Soft flags are named on the point.
method.blending: the box is 31″ across: a neighbour within about 15″ adds its light, which at SPHEREx’s 6″ pixels is often the case
